historical_intake.intake_statement: Prove theta(p_c) = 0 for Bernoulli percolation on Z^d for every d >= 3; open for 3 <= d <= 10 (known for d >= 11 by Fitzner and van der Hofstad, and for d = 2).
historical_intake.primary_quote: It is a major open question to prove that this is also the case for intermediate dimensions; the consensus is that this should be the case.
historical_intake.quote_context: Chapter XI, printed p. 134 (PDF p. 136); preceding sentence says no percolation at criticality for d>=19, and the proof on that page refers to open edges. The 3..10 bound is a later update, not the 2012 text.

working_exact_bond_statement: For each integer 3 <= d <= 10, independent Bernoulli(p) nearest-neighbor edges of Z^d form no infinite open cluster almost surely at p=p_c(d), where p_c(d)=inf{p in [0,1]: P_p(|C(0)|=infinity)>0}.

new_primary_evidence.source: OpenAI, Critical bond and site percolation on the cubic lattice, 2026-09-24, Theorem 1.1
new_primary_evidence.exact_quote: For nearest-neighbor Bernoulli bond percolation on Z3, there is almost surely no infinite open cluster at the bond critical parameter. The same assertion holds for nearest-neighbor Bernoulli site percolation at the site critical parameter.
new_primary_evidence.scope: d=3 only; manuscript proof not independently refereed here

new_primary_evidence.quote: The formalization proves absence of an infinite cluster at criticality for Bernoulli bond percolation on every infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph with critical probability p_c<1.
new_primary_evidence.scope: All assigned d if its formalized theorem and lattice instantiation audit clean; comparator challenge file contains a deliberate sorry, so challenge alone is not a proof receipt

new_primary_evidence.source: OpenAI, No percolation at criticality on quasi-transitive graphs, 2026-09-24, Theorem 1.1
new_primary_evidence.exact_quote: Let G be an infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive undirected graph. If pc(G) < 1, then Ppc(G)(there is an infinite open cluster) = 0.
new_primary_evidence.scope: Includes nearest-neighbor bond percolation on Z^d for all d>=2, provided its proof is sound; this 42-page manuscript has not received a full independent audit by w422

formal_check.warning: Do not count challenge-file sorry or documentation alone as proof.
